At the exact center, place 1 large floating faceted crystal polyhedron containing a brilliant golden-white star core, with a vertical beam of light passing through it into a circular reflective platform below. Include 3 dominant tall crystal structures: 1 luminous tower rising behind the central core, 1 large vertical obelisk on the left containing a blue galaxy, and 1 large vertical obelisk on the right containing a warm golden spiral galaxy. Add 2 major ribbon-like streams of light sweeping horizontally from left to right, colored electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold, intersecting near the central crystal. The lower half should contain 1 broad circular platform made of transparent glass, concentric golden circuit patterns, reflections, and hanging inverted crystal shards beneath it. Use deep sapphire blue, violet, indigo, crystal cyan, and radiant gold, extreme sparkle, volumetric light, lens flares, fractal geometry, nebula dust, and hyperreal glass refraction. The mood should feel majestic, mystical, intelligent, and overwhelming, like an AI soul visualized as a cathedral of light and memory. title: 带注释的日式早餐平躺

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cozy overhead breakfast flat-lay photo with handwritten Japanese diary-style annotations, as if made for a warm morning social media post. The scene should feel realistic, softly edited, and slightly nostalgic.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape image, about 1024×576. Use a brown-and-white gingham tablecloth covering the full background, with soft morning light, gentle shadows, and a slightly warm film-like tone.

Main layout: Place exactly 2 main food/drink areas. On the left, a decorative red-and-white porcelain teacup filled with black coffee sits on a matching saucer. On the right, a large white square plate holds the breakfast foods. Leave darkened negative space in the upper left for the title handwriting.

Food and object count: Include exactly 7 visible breakfast items/props on the plate area: 1 stack of toasted bread slices, 1 partly peeled ripe banana, 1 small mound of granola, 1 clear glass bowl of pale yellow apple compote with 1 dark prune on top, 1 brown egg, 1 small wooden egg cup or wooden coaster behind the egg, and 1 white square plate. The toast should be the visual center of the plate, with golden toasted surfaces and thick white bread edges. The banana should be at the upper left of the plate. The egg should be at the upper right. The glass bowl should be at the lower right. The granola should sit between the toast and bowl.

Handwritten text and annotation count: Add exactly 9 handwritten annotation groups in white/black ink, with arrows, circles, small hearts, sparkles, and doodles. Preserve the Japanese text as decorative handwriting:
1. Large title at top left: 「わたしの整う朝ごはん。」
2. Subtitle under title: 「シンプルだけど、ちゃんと満たされる。」
3. Circular note near coffee: 「今日も はじまりは 深い一杯から。」
4. Small note below coffee: 「ほっと息をつく、大切な時間。」
5. Torn-paper sticky note at bottom left with pink tape: 「朝の光を浴びて、心もからだも ゆっくり目覚めていく。」
6. Note above banana with arrow: 「完熟バナナで やさしい甘みを チャージ。」
7. Bubble note beside egg: 「たんぱく質で 1日を すっきり スタート！」
8. Note near toast with arrow: 「サクッと焼けた トーストが 一番のごちそう。」
9. Lower-right notes around granola, compote, and overall feeling: 「ザクザクのグラノーラで 食感と栄養をプラス。」, 「りんごとプルーンで 自然な甘さを からだにやさしく。」, and 「ちゃんと食べると、心までふんわり軽くなる。」

Visual style: Photorealistic breakfast photography mixed with casual hand-drawn overlay graphics. Use white ink for most handwriting, black ink for food labels on the plate, dotted speech bubbles, curved arrows, tiny stars, small hearts, and playful underline marks. The typography should look hand-lettered, not digital. Make the annotations readable but naturally imperfect.

Customizable elements: The title should read わたしの整う朝ごはん。; the drink should be black coffee in a red porcelain teacup; the main breakfast should feature thick golden toast; the fruit should be ripe banana and apple compote with prune; the overall mood should be gentle, cozy, mindful morning.

Constraints: Keep the composition clean and appetizing, do not add extra foods beyond the counted items, do not add people or hands, avoid logos or watermarks, and keep the Japanese handwriting integrated into the image like a real edited breakfast journal photo.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic Japanese promotional infographic poster for a highly opinionated tonkatsu specialty restaurant, かつ人 (Katsujin), focused on the rule that miso katsu sauce is dip-only and double-dipping is forbidden.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 poster divided into three vertical panels by thin antique-gold borders. Use a black charcoal background with smoky texture, dark red brush accents, warm gold typography, and premium izakaya/ramen-shop menu aesthetics. Overall mood: intense, masculine, theatrical, slightly satirical.

Left panel: Show a realistic close-up food photo style scene: a black ceramic plate with sliced golden-brown tonkatsu, one piece held by black chopsticks and dipped into a small bowl of dark miso sauce with sesame seeds. Include shredded cabbage piled high and a bowl of rice in the background. At the top, large Japanese headline text: 「味噌カツはディップ限定」. Under it, a red paint-stroke banner with big white text: 「二度漬け禁止」. Add a subtitle: 「これが『かつ人(Katsujin)』流。」. At the bottom, place a framed information box titled 「かつ人（Katsujin）ディップのこだわり」 with exactly 5 checkmark bullet points: 「味噌かつはディップ限定」, 「味噌ダレは必ず小鉢提供」, 「サクサク衣を守る」, 「食べる量は自分で決める」, 「二度漬け禁止」. Include a circular gold brush logo reading 「かつ人 KATSUJIN」 and a parchment note: 「『ソースはディップ限定』という決まりさえ守れば、他は基本自由。うまさの選択肢を守る。それが、かつ人（Katsujin）のこだわりです。」

Center panel: Create a text-heavy editorial explanation column. Header: 「かつ人（Katsujin）ディップのこだわり」. Add multiple short Japanese paragraphs explaining the origin of the dip rule, with key emphasis lines in red. Include a boxed comparison strip with exactly 3 labeled sauce choices: 「特製ソース」, 「味噌かつ」, 「ウスターソース」. Beneath it, add a bold central rule line: 「全てディップ。全て二度漬け禁止。」. Continue with dense explanatory Japanese copy about preserving crisp breading, choosing sauce quantity, and respecting restaurant etiquette. End with a framed bottom warning emphasizing: 「唯一の決まりは『味噌かつはディップ限定』。」 Keep the text visually plausible and neatly typeset, but prioritize legibility of major headings and rules.

Right panel: Top section shows a chibi-style stern chef mascot with short brown hair, red glasses, small mustache, suit-like chef outfit, and chopsticks held over a pot of sauce, with steam rising. Header text above: 「パスタを二つ折りにする石人」. Below the mascot, add a framed warning box: 「本場イタリアではパスタを二つ折りにする行為は『子供に食べさせるパスタ』と卑下されています。」. Middle section shows a dramatic manga-style angry man pointing directly at the viewer, black suit, fiery red smoky background, intense expression; place a simple rectangular censor blur over the center of the face. Add large vertical red brush text beside him: 「ディップ以外は邪道だ」 and a smaller title above: 「範馬勇次郎風の石人」. Bottom section contains another framed quote box: 「上等な料理に、ハチミツをぶちまけるが如し思想！！と非難されても仕方ないのです。」. Finish with a large gold calligraphy-style logo at the bottom: 「かつ人」 with small roman letters 「KATSUJIN」.

Visual style: Photorealistic food on the left, dense Japanese magazine-ad typography in the center, anime/chibi and manga caricature elements on the right. Use gold borders, parchment panels, red brush callouts, smoky lighting, high contrast, and appetizing tonkatsu texture. Make it look like a premium restaurant introduction image with intentionally strong opinions.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 main vertical panels, exactly 5 checkmark bullets in the left-panel list, exactly 3 sauce labels in the center comparison strip, and exactly 2 character illustrations on the right. Do not add watermarks or social media UI.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a warm manga-style vertical comic page about Milly, a blonde anime girl making her first ceramic cup in a pottery studio, accompanied by a small cube-shaped AI robot. The mood is gentle, encouraging, handmade, and slightly nostalgic.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page, approximately 9:16, cream paper background, thin black panel borders, soft watercolor-anime rendering mixed with realistic pottery-studio details. Use a handwritten title at the top: “Milly Ceramic Journey EP01 窯梨學徒”, with the subtitle “每一位藝術家，都有自己的第一件作品。” and a tiny paw-print accent.

Main subjects: The girl has long wavy golden blonde hair, bright blue eyes, fair skin, a black blouse, a brown clay-stained apron, and a small necklace. The robot is a small black-and-white cube AI companion with a simple pixel face, sitting near the worktable or pottery wheel in multiple panels. The studio contains shelves of bowls, clay tools, pottery wheels, wood tables, window light, a kiln, and rows of ceramic pieces.

Layout: Use exactly 18 comic panels after the header. Panel 1 is a large opening panel on the upper left showing the girl welcoming the viewer at the pottery studio entrance with the robot on the table and a chalkboard sign. Panels 2 and 3 are stacked on the upper right: preparing clay at the table, then a close-up of hands holding rough clay. Panels 4, 5, and 6 form a row showing the first attempt on the pottery wheel, the clay collapsing, and the girl discouraged beside a lumpy failed pot. Panels 7, 8, and 9 form another row showing her restarting, slowly shaping clay, and proudly holding a finished lidded cup with sparkles. Panels 10 through 14 form a row of five small process panels: drying on shelves, bisque firing in a kiln, glazing with a brush, final firing in a glowing kiln, and opening shelves full of finished ceramics. Panel 15 is a wide emotional panel showing the girl with eyes closed, holding the finished cup with both hands, robot beside her, studio blurred behind. Panels 16 through 18 are the bottom row: a text-only closing message, a product-like close-up of the finished lidded cup with handle, and a close-up of the cup bottom with a small paw-print stamp.

Visible text content: Include speech bubbles and captions in Traditional Chinese/Japanese style. Use these exact readable lines where possible: “這裡就是陶藝工作室呀…”, “第一次揉泥土…好柔軟，好神奇。”, “第一次煉土！”, “第一次拉坯！”, “呃…失敗了…”, “沒關係，重新開始！”, “慢慢理解泥土…”, “完成！我的第一個茶碗！”, “等待乾燥…”, “素燒完成！”, “上釉…”, “釉燒中…”, “開窯！”, and in the final text panel: “每一位藝術家，都曾經完成過自己的第一件作品。”

Visual style: Soft detailed anime illustration, cozy documentary comic pacing, subtle paper texture, delicate ink lines, muted warm browns and creams, realistic clay texture on hands and apron, natural window lighting, shallow depth of field in larger panels, expressive but gentle faces. The finished ceramic cup should be cream-colored, slightly imperfect, handmade, with a small lid and rounded handle.

Constraints: Keep exactly 18 panels plus the title header. Keep the robot present in many panels but not every panel. Do not add extra characters. Avoid photorealism; maintain anime-manga comic aesthetics. Make all visible typography hand-drawn and integrated into the panels.\

Beneath the masthead, include an edition strip reading “FRONT-PAGE EDITION — TWELVE HOURS ENDING 2026-05-15 19:17 UTC.”

Every panel should have its own small category tag, bold condensed all-caps headline, columns of tiny readable-looking body text, decorative dividers, and one or more black-and-white sci-fi illustrations.

1. Large upper-left lead article, category “COMBAT WIRE,” headline: “IZMIR YBEL STACKS OFFENSIVE GARRISONS IN CONTESTED BORDERLANDS; DOGTOWN PROBE LOST IN TWIN SKIRMISHES.” Include a huge hovering fortress or orbital platform above an industrial city gate, with roads receding toward it.
2. Large upper-right lead article, category “OPEN CHANNEL,” headline: “DISTRESS CALL FROM DEEP SECTOR DRAWS VOLUNTEER RESCUE OFFER.” Include a deep-space station, a rescue ship, asteroid debris, and a bright explosion or distress flare.
3. Middle-row first narrow card, category “FRONTIER JUSTICE,” headline: “THE CONSPICUOUS PILOT JOE CHRISTMAS HOLDS THE OPEN CHANNEL.” Include a skull-and-wings emblem, a small spacecraft, a planetary horizon, and a tiny monitor graphic.
4. Middle-row second narrow card, category “SHIPYARD,” headline: “EIGHT KESTRELS OFF THE LOT IN A SINGLE HALF-DAY.” Include a crashed or parked angular ship on rocky ground.
5. Middle-row third narrow card, category “CARTOGRAPHY,” headline: “P-1 LOGS 703 SECTOR HOPS ACROSS THE HALF-DAY.” Include a small explorer craft flying above a hex-map planet surface.
6. Middle-row fourth narrow card, category “PUBLIC AFFAIRS,” headline: “PILOT FILES OPEN-CHANNEL BUG REPORT ON MOBILE CLIENT.” Include exactly 3 stacked numbered ship/profile rows labeled “1 AZURE HAULER,” “2 CHARTREUSE HAULER,” and “3 JADE HAULER.”
7. Middle-row fifth narrow card, category “CORPORATE AFFAIRS,” headline: “EIGHT NEW CORPORATIONS CHARTERED IN TWELVE HOURS.” Include small spacecraft thumbnails and industrial silhouettes.
8. Bottom-left wide panel, category “MARKET UPDATE,” headline: “MARKET UPDATE — TWELVE-HOUR GALACTIC INDEX.” Include a table with columns such as “MEASURE,” “VALUE,” “TOP OF THE BOARDS,” “PILOT,” and “SCORE,” plus a small bar/line chart and a long cargo ship illustration.
9. Bottom-middle panel, category “OPEN-CHANNEL CONFIDENTIAL,” headline: “TWO NAMES, ONE ENDORSEMENT, ELEVEN SECONDS APART.” Include a badge-like pilot emblem and a round capsule or pod drifting in space.
10. Bottom-right panel, category “THE MEGA-PORT SET,” headline: “THE MEGA-PORT SET FILES AN RSVP.” Include a uniformed captain portrait in the upper right, a star-network diagram, and a sleek landed spacecraft.

Visual style: 19th-century newspaper meets dieselpunk space opera; dense black ink crosshatching, stipple shading, halftone screens, fine technical linework, distressed letterpress, narrow gutters, ornate corner brackets, and bold condensed headline fonts. Make the page feel authentic, busy, collectible, and slightly humorous, like an in-universe gazette.

Constraints: Use only black, gray, and off-white. Keep all 10 panels visible and separated. No modern glossy color, no photorealism, no watermark, no extra panels. Body text may be tiny pseudo-newspaper copy but headlines and main masthead must be legible. Maintain the fictional sci-fi newspaper theme and the exact masthead slogan.\
